leader_skill.desc: 120% Atk, Def, Rec, 140% max HP, restores HP each turn, fills BB gauge each turn, probable 1 KO resistance & negates all status ailments and Atk, Def, Rec reduction
leader_skill.name: Sikuri Savant

extra_skill.desc: 25% all parameters, 5% damage reduction for all allies, restores HP each turn, 1 KO resistance when HP is below 40% & 100% critical, elemental damage reduction
extra_skill.name: Song of Serenity

bb.desc: 6 combo Earth attack on all foes (partial HP drain), restores HP for 3 turns, boosts max HP, 15% damage reduction from all element types for 3 turns, removes all status ailments and Atk, Def, Rec reduction & fills OD gauge
bb.name: Enchanted Harmony

sbb.desc: 8 combo Earth attack on all foes (partial HP drain), restores HP, adds Earth barrier, 15% damage reduction from all element types for 3 turns, may raise allies from KO  & fills OD gauge per ally
sbb.name: Ancient Melody

ubb.desc: 15 combo Earth attack on all foes (damage relative to remaining HP), boosts Atk, Def, Rec  and critical rate for 4 turns, boosts max HP, damage taken fills BB gauge for 4 turns, damage taken restores HP for 4 turns & raises allies from KO
ubb.name: Dance of the Fairies
